title: 伦敦资管Kevin Zhao：AI配置热潮未见顶，现在说泡沫还太早？
speaker: Kevin Zhao

segments.en: Well, that's what I think, you know, every day market always some news noise, you know.
segments.zh: 嗯，这就是我的看法，你知道，每天市场总有些新闻噪音。

segments.en: But I think the most important from my experience focused on global macro, one is the, you know, pattern because we're trying to predict the future, of course, the future is unknown,
segments.zh: 但根据我关注全球宏观的经验，最重要的是模式，因为我们试图预测未来，当然未来是未知的。

segments.en: you know. But we can't go back history. So I said the best, you know, period for today is the 96, 2000.
segments.zh: 你知道，但我们无法回到历史。所以我说，今天最好的参照期是96年、2000年。

segments.en: But the problem then, the next one is the momentum, you know, is the economy still upturn?
segments.zh: 但接下来的问题是动能，经济是否仍在上升？

segments.en: Or is running over? My personal feeling is still upturn because, you know, if you look at AI investment, you know, 1.4 trillion, you know, most people forecast 5 trillion and the media sells just double.
segments.zh: 还是已经结束？我个人感觉仍在上升，因为如果你看AI**，1.4万亿，大多数人预测5万亿，而媒体只报道翻倍。

segments.en: So it's, people say, well, you know, AI investment boom, but the evidence is not there, you know, the data still moving up.
segments.zh: 所以人们说AI**热潮，但证据并不充分，数据仍在上升。

segments.en: So I think, you know, so in three years time, maybe where, you know, X will say, well, you know, bubble.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，三年后，也许有人会说泡沫。

segments.en: But the point of making, you know, from the data being monitored for the last 33 years, there's no strong evidence, you know.
segments.zh: 但关键在于，从过去33年监测的数据来看，没有强有力的证据。
